title: DOT is now vibe-coded/slopware – alternatives/forks?
author: Natureshadow
body_preview: As can be seen in recent pull requests, "AI" is not only used for code review, but entire PRs, issues, and changelogs are generated using LLMs.  This issue is intended to track any forks or alternatives to replace DOT.  So, if anyone knows of well-maintained forks that are not slop-infested, or of alternatives that can replace DOT, please add them here.

title: Policy setting: allow a refresh token to survive access-token revocation (4.x)
author: dopry
body_preview: ## Background  As part of the #746 fix, revoking an access token (via the RFC 7009 `/revoke/` endpoint) now also revokes the refresh token bound to it — matching the admin "delete access token" view and RFC 7009 §2.1, which says the server **MAY** revoke the respective refresh token. title: Explore runtime token-cleanup strategies (reduce reliance on a long-running cleartokens)
author: dopry
body_preview: ## Motivation  `cleartokens` is a management command that operators routinely **forget to schedule**, so expired token rows pile up (access/refresh/ID tokens, grants). And when it finally is run against a large, long-neglected table it becomes a **long-running, heavy delete**. We'd like a way to keep token-table volume bounded *automatically*, in small increments, without depending on an out-of-ba...

title: Natively support CORS on the OIDC UserInfo endpoint
author: dopry
body_preview: ### Summary  DOT already emits CORS headers for every browser-reachable OIDC/metadata endpoint **except** the UserInfo endpoint. Adding native CORS support to UserInfo would let JavaScript clients call it out of the box, align with the OIDC spec, and remove the need for users to bolt on `django-cors-headers` (as our own reference IDP has to).
